title: The Princess and the Goblin
description: Princess Irene discovers a mysterious great-great-grandmother in a hidden tower while the miner boy Curdie uncovers a goblin plot beneath the mountain.
catalogueBlurb: A hidden tower, a silver thread and goblins beneath the mountain.

rights.curatorNotes: Twelve reader sections preserve Irene, Curdie, the mysterious grandmother, the silver thread, the goblin plot and the flooding of the underground kingdom while making the Victorian prose more accessible. R6.5-WP19SH1.5.3 adds a separately selectable 15-image generated Modern Illustrations set while preserving Jessie Willcox Smith as Classic Illustrations.

edition.source: Project Gutenberg eBook #34339 (1920 David McKay illustrated edition)
edition.notes: Story House pagination changes presentation only; all 32 chapters and the original wording remain complete.

rights.curatorNotes: All 32 chapters reflowed into 127 reader pages at paragraph boundaries, using semantic resume anchors and all eight historical Jessie Willcox Smith plates. Fourteen matching images from the R6.5-WP19SH1.5.3 generated set are available as Modern Illustrations; the quiet Story House-only closing tower scene is intentionally not attached to the Full Classic text because MacDonald's ending does not stage that visit.
